purpose: 人员安排板块功能重规划的本地业务数据只读基线；仅包含汇总，不包含原始个人或业务内容。

workspace_scope.selection: Only workspace present in this database; workspace ID and account identity are deliberately omitted.

read_method.connection: Python sqlite3 URI mode=ro; PRAGMA query_only=ON; BEGIN read transaction; no Repository constructor, migrations, writes, or write APIs.
read_method.processing: JSON records were parsed in process; only explicitly constructed aggregate output is retained. No names, account IDs, email addresses, task/project titles, log bodies, credentials, tokens, or password hashes are written to this evidence file.

field_definitions.stored_tasks: All task rows in the selected workspace before parent/voided exclusions.
field_definitions.parent_tasks: Task ID referenced by any stored task.parentId; detect parents before any scope/status filter.
field_definitions.effective_leaf_tasks: Tasks that are not voided and whose IDs are not in the complete parent-ID set.
field_definitions.open: Effective leaf status is not done.
field_definitions.unassigned: No assigneeId and trimmed lower-case assignee is empty or one of unassigned, 未分配, 待补, 未指定.
field_definitions.text_assignee_only: No assigneeId, with a nonempty non-sentinel responsibility text; this is not confirmed natural-person identity.
field_definitions.with_assignee_id: A stored account identity reference; existing model expects a workspace member account ID, not employee ID.
field_definitions.with_work_dates: A nonempty workDates array, counting each task once even when it has several dates.
field_definitions.work_week_without_dates: A nonempty workWeek and empty/missing workDates.
field_definitions.without_work_plan_regardless_of_status: Neither workWeek nor any workDates, including already-completed tasks.
field_definitions.unplanned_open: Open task without workWeek or any workDates; corresponds to taskIsUnplanned.
field_definitions.week_scope: Effective leaves whose workWeek is exactly 2026-10-12. This excludes all tasks with no workWeek.
field_definitions.overdue_open: Open leaf with explicit dueDate earlier than 2026-10-17. Estimated/schedule/work dates do not substitute for dueDate.
field_definitions.project_members: Automatically recorded project editors under the current API, not an authoritative project staffing roster.
field_definitions.exact_unique_name_candidate: Text exactly matches one employee name; only a review candidate, not an identity assertion or automatic link.

task_population.reconciliation: 115 stored - 1 parent - 1 voided + 0 overlap = 113 effective leaves

open_backlog_overlap_across_all_time.reconciliation: 78 unassigned + 78 unplanned - 73 both = 83 unique open tasks needing at least one of these two fields.

screenshot_week_reconciliation.source: User-provided personnel arrangements screenshot; current week 2026-10-12 and UTC displayed.
screenshot_week_reconciliation.interpretation: The two rows are responsibility groups, not evidence of a two-person workforce. The seven day cells count task-date appearances, while week totals deduplicate task IDs.

limitations_and_metric_overlaps: This is the configured local SQLite database, not a separately verified production dataset. No authenticated API or browser state was used for this extraction.
The workspace stores UTC although the client context is Asia/Shanghai; this baseline preserves that setting and does not migrate dates.

All-time statistics and week-filtered statistics have different populations. A week filter requiring workWeek cannot expose tasks without any workWeek; therefore the screenshot unplanned=0 does not mean no backlog.
Unassigned and unplanned are overlapping flags, not mutually exclusive status buckets. Their sum must not be displayed as a unique task total.
Blocked and overdue can overlap each other and open/unassigned/unplanned; do not sum these flags into a total risk count without task-ID deduplication.
Done in the weekly view means currently done among tasks assigned to that work week, not tasks completed during that week.
Only 6 of 113 effective leaves have dueDate. The 1 overdue item reflects explicit deadlines only; absent deadlines mean unknown deadline risk.
Task counts and workDates do not measure hours, available capacity, utilization, effort, productivity, idle time, or overload.
Employee.active and account.status are separate facts. No task association on an unlinked employee must not be interpreted as zero work.
Text names, even exact unique employee-name matches, require explicit identity confirmation; they do not establish assigneeId or actor identity.
The 37 project_members rows all belong to one editing account. They describe current editing history and are not valid evidence of 37 staffed project memberships.
Daily-log schema currently stores a text reporter, not a stable reporter ID; the API returns only the latest 50 batches. This local database currently has zero daily-log batches.

Only 10 explicit non-done-to-done transitions were found compared with 29 currently done leaves. Imported/current statuses and incomplete audit history cannot support a comprehensive completion throughput series.
Synthetic performance fixtures in docs/evidence/people-domain-baseline-* are excluded from these business-data counts.
